items.titleZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛发车格：四次罚退调整顺序
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛从杆位发车，但发车格顺序因四次独立的罚退而与排位赛结果不同。
items.originalTitle: Azerbaijan Grand Prix starting grid with four penalties
items.summaryEn: George Russell is set to start the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from pole, but the grid order has been altered by four separate grid penalties compared to the qualifying results.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛从杆位发车，但他身后的发车格顺序与排位赛顺序并不完全一致。
四次独立的发车格罚退——尽管其中三次是给明显处于后段的赛车——目前已经使发车格相对于排位赛结果发生了变化。
以下是周六发车格顺序的最新情况……
塞恩斯因黄旗违规被罚退5位
佩雷兹因阻挡被罚退3位
阿隆索因更换引擎部件被罚至队尾
斯特罗尔因更换引擎部件被罚至队尾
detailEn: George Russell is set to start the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from pole - but the grid order behind him isn't quite what the qualifying order was.
Four separate grid penalties - though three of them given to firmly backmarking cars - have so far altered the grid relative to qualifying results.
Below is the latest on the Saturday grid order...
Sainz has five-place penalty for yellow flag breach
Perez has three-place grid penalty for impeding
Alonso has back-of-grid penalty for engine components
Stroll has back-of-grid penalty for engine components
keyPointsZh: 塞恩斯因黄旗违规被罚退5位
佩雷兹因阻挡被罚退3位
阿隆索和斯特罗尔因更换引擎部件被罚至队尾
keyPointsEn: Sainz has a five-place penalty for a yellow flag breach
Perez has a three-place grid penalty for impeding
Alonso and Stroll have back-of-grid penalties for engine components

items.originalTitle: Carlos Sainz handed Azerbaijan F1 grid drop for yellow flag breach
items.summaryEn: Williams driver Carlos Sainz has been handed a five-place grid drop for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix for speeding under yellow flags in qualifying, while Cadillac's Sergio Perez received a three-place grid drop for impeding McLaren's Oscar Piastri in Q1.
detailZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯因黄旗下超速被罚阿塞拜疆F1正赛退后发车
卡洛斯·塞恩斯因在黄旗下超速，失去了威廉姆斯艰难拼下的F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛Q3席位，而塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹则因阻挡被罚。
威廉姆斯车手卡洛斯·塞恩斯因在排位赛黄旗下超速，被罚在周六巴库举行的阿塞拜疆大奖赛正赛退后五位发车。
Q3尾声，塞恩斯是第三辆受到3号弯黄旗影响的车，该黄旗是因为兰多·诺里斯冲出赛道进入逃生路而出示的。当塞恩斯接近刹车区时，诺里斯已经回到赛道上，但这位西班牙人仍须遵守进入这个90度左弯前的局部黄旗。
塞恩斯的比赛工程师告知他前方有“黄旗”，并要求他在弯中“稍微抬油”。但国际汽联的比赛仲裁发现，这位威廉姆斯车手只在两个受影响的马歇尔赛段（4号和5号）中的一个抬了油，随后给予他退后五位的处罚。
塞恩斯辩称他在整个路段已经减够了速度，但由于他在第4马歇尔赛段做出了本节最快的小赛段成绩，仲裁不认同他的做法。
“SAI解释说，他打算展示在整个黄旗区域内减速，”仲裁在解释中写道。“他表示，他认为没有必要在直道上减速，而是打算在接近和驶出3号弯时展示他的反应。”
“他认为这是一个覆盖连续黄旗赛段的‘整体抬油’。他还解释说，最初引发黄旗的赛车已不在缓冲区，他预计黄旗会被撤销。”
“仲裁不接受这一解释。当连续的马歇尔赛段处于黄旗状态时，车手必须在每个单独的黄旗马歇尔赛段展示明显的减速反应。在后一个赛段减速不能追溯满足前一个黄旗赛段的要求。”
仲裁补充道：“这一义务也不取决于车手自己对原始危险是否仍存在于黄旗赛段某一部位的判断。遥测数据清楚显示，SAI对黄旗的反应只发生在第5马歇尔赛段。在第4马歇尔赛段没有可现实地归因于对黄旗反应的明显减速。事实上，SAI在第4马歇尔赛段做出了本节最快成绩。”
因此，塞恩斯被罚退后五位发车，从周六发车格的第9位降至第14位。这一处罚抹去了威廉姆斯为重返Q3所做的一些努力，他们为巴库站准备了全新的轻量化底盘和重新设计的地板。
塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹因在巴库危险的最后一弯阻挡被罚
凯迪拉克车手塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹因在Q1阻挡迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，被罚退后三位发车。佩雷兹当时正在巴库2公里长直道的蜿蜒路段做准备圈，这一路段因准备圈中节省电量的赛车与全力冲刺的赛车之间存在巨大速度差而引发争议。
佩雷兹没有遵守赛事总监鲁伊·马克斯要求留在赛道最左侧以避免危险接近的指示，皮亚斯特里以快50公里/小时的速度遇到佩雷兹的凯迪拉克，不得不收油。
仲裁认定该事件并非特别危险，但仍因阻挡皮亚斯特里以及未遵守赛事总监的明确指示而处罚佩雷兹。
不过，佩雷兹预计仍将从原来的第20位发车，因为他身后的两辆车——阿斯顿·马丁的费尔南多·阿隆索和兰斯·斯特罗尔——带有严重得多的引擎相关罚退。
detailEn: Carlos Sainz handed Azerbaijan F1 grid drop for yellow flag breach
Carlos Sainz loses Williams' hard-earned Q3 spot at Formula 1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix after speeding under yellow flags, while Sergio Perez was slapped with an impeding penalty
Williams driver Carlos Sainz has been handed a five-place grid drop for Saturday's Azerbaijan GP in Baku as a punishment for speeding under yellow flags in qualifying.

At the end of Q3, Sainz was the last of three cars to be hindered by a yellow flag in Turn 3 for Lando Norris, who had gone off into the escape road. As Sainz approached the braking zone, Norris had already returned to the track, but the Spaniard still had to observe a local yellow into the 90-degree left-hander.

Sainz was told by his race engineer of the "yellow" ahead and asked for a "little lift" into the corner. But the FIA's race stewards found that the Williams driver only lifted in one of the two affected marshal sectors, four and five, and subsequently handed him a five-place grid drop.
Sainz argued that he had scrubbed off enough speed across the entire stretch, but as he set his best mini sector of the session in Marshalling Sector 4, the stewards disagreed with his approach.

"SAI explained that he intended to demonstrate a reduction in speed across the Yellow area as a whole," the stewards wrote in their explanation. "He stated that he did not consider it necessary to reduce speed on the straight and instead intended to demonstrate his response when approaching and exiting Turn 3.

"He considered this to be a 'global lift' covering the consecutive Yellow sectors. He further explained that the car which had originally caused the Yellow was no longer in the run-off area and that he expected the Yellow Flags to be withdrawn.

"The Stewards did not accept this interpretation. Where consecutive marshalling sectors are subject to Yellow Flag conditions, a driver must demonstrate a significant reaction to reduce speed in each individual Yellow marshalling sector. A reduction in a subsequent sector cannot retrospectively satisfy the requirement applicable to the preceding Yellow sector."

The stewards added: "The obligation is also not dependent on the driver’s own assessment of whether the original hazard remains present within a particular part of the Yellow sector. The telemetry clearly showed that SAI’s reaction to the Yellow occurred only in Marshalling Sector 5. There was no meaningful reduction in speed in Marshalling Sector 4 which could realistically be attributed to a response to the Yellow. Indeed, SAI recorded his fastest time of the session in Marshalling Sector 4."

As a result, Sainz received a five-place grid drop, demoting him from ninth to 14th on Saturday's starting grid. The penalty undoes some of the hard work Williams had done to make it back into Q3, having prepared an all-new, lightened chassis and a redesigned floor for the Baku event.
Sergio Perez pulled up for impeding in Baku's risky final sector

Cadillac driver Sergio Perez received a three-place grid drop for impeding McLaren's Oscar Piastri in Q1. Perez was on a preparation lap on the snaking section of Baku's 2km long straight, which had been the subject of debate because of the major closing speeds between cars conserving battery charge on a preparation lap and those pushing flat out.

Perez did not heed race director Rui Marques request to remain on the extreme left-hand side of the track to avoid dangerous close calls, with Piastri encountering Perez's Cadillac while going 50km/h faster and having to come off the throttle.
The stewards determined the incident wasn't particularly dangerous, but still punished Perez for impeding Piastri and for not obeying the race directors' express instructions.
However, Perez is still expected to start from his original 20th position as the two cars behind him, Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll, carry much bigger engine-related grid penalties.
keyPointsZh: 塞恩斯从第九位降至第14位发车，威廉姆斯为本站准备了全新轻量化底盘和重新设计的地板。
佩雷兹预计仍将从原第20位发车，因为其身后的阿隆索和斯特罗尔有更严重的引擎相关罚退。
keyPointsEn: Sainz drops from ninth to 14th on the grid, undoing Williams' work after preparing an all-new, lightened chassis and a redesigned floor for Baku.
Perez is still expected to start from his original 20th position as the two cars behind him, Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll, carry much bigger engine-related grid penalties.

items.titleZh: 塞恩斯无视黄旗被罚退五位，威廉姆斯错过赛季最佳发车位
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车手卡洛斯·塞恩斯因在阿塞拜疆大奖赛排位赛中无视黄旗被罚退五位发车，这让威廉姆斯失去本赛季最佳发车位。此前他在周五练习赛中也因黄旗违规被调查，但获情有可原处理后仅受训诫。
items.originalTitle: Sainz loses Williams's best grid slot of 2026
items.summaryEn: Williams driver Carlos Sainz has received a five-place grid penalty for ignoring yellow flags during Azerbaijan Grand Prix qualifying, denying the team its best grid position of the year. He had earlier been investigated for a separate yellow-flag breach in Friday practice but escaped with only a reprimand due to mitigating circumstances.
detailZh: 威廉姆斯车队的F1车手卡洛斯·塞恩斯因在阿塞拜疆大奖赛排位赛中无视黄旗，被处以发车位置退后五位的处罚。
这一处罚使威廉姆斯失去了本可成为车队本赛季最佳发车位的位置，超过了阿尔本在摩纳哥大奖赛上取得的第11位发车位。
值得注意的是，这一处罚出炉的当天，塞恩斯其实已经因另一起黄旗违规事件接受了调查并被判定违规，不过那次由于有可减轻情节，他只受到了警告。
塞恩斯和威廉姆斯车队最初是在周五上午练习赛之后，因第四弯的黄旗违规被传唤到赛事干事面前的。赛事干事裁定塞恩斯在黄旗情况下“未能充分降低车速”——但认为“在单黄旗出示到塞恩斯进入相关救援区域之间的极短时间内”存在足够的可减轻情节，因此避免了对他处以发车位处罚。
另一起发生在第三节排位赛中的事故则不存在这样的缓解因素。事实上，干事们指出，赛恩斯已经提前收到车队关于3号弯前出现黄旗的警告，但没有足够地加以注意。
所涉及的警告内容是“前方黄旗，前方黄旗，[兰多]诺里斯，只需抬一次油门，抬一次油门，然后完成这一圈”，随后几秒钟又传来明显的“解除—解除”——这似乎造成了一种局面，让赛恩斯认为黄旗已不再迫切相关。
“[赛恩斯]解释说，他打算在整个黄旗区域内表现出整体降速，”干事们在一大段解释中如此写道。
“他表示，他认为没有必要在直道上减速，而是打算在接近和驶出3号弯时展示自己的反应。他认为这是一种覆盖连续黄旗区域的‘整体抬油门’。他进一步解释说，最初引发黄旗的那辆[诺里斯的]赛车已经不在缓冲区里了，他预计黄旗会被撤下。
"干事们不接受这种解释。当连续的多个裁判分区都处于黄旗状态时，车手必须在每一个黄旗裁判分区内都表现出明显的减速反应。在后续分区中的减速不能追溯性地满足适用于前一个黄旗分区的要求。这一义务也不取决于车手自己对黄旗分区内特定路段是否仍存在原始危险的自行判断。"
迈凯伦车手诺里斯当时确实已经驶离了相关的缓冲区——但由于国际汽联干事们不希望车手自行判断黄旗的有效性，他们认为在相关裁判分区内缺乏任何"有意义的减速"已足以构成处罚的理由。"
除了这个从第九位降至第十四位的五位处罚之外，赛恩斯还被记了两分罚分——使他在12个月周期内的罚分总数达到四分。
在巴库排位赛之后，赛恩斯并不是唯一一位受到发车格处罚的车手。
凯迪拉克车手塞尔希奥·佩雷斯因为在第一节中阻挡迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里而被判罚退后三位。
干事们在报告中写道，佩雷斯虽然从车队那里"收到了两次无线电警告"，但由于"没有按照特定的交通管理指示来管理自己的准备圈"——即赛事总监要求处于准备圈的车手保持在右侧、避免在驶来的赛车前方蛇行穿行——他仍然迫使迈凯伦车手在18、19、20号弯路段不必要地松开了油门。
不过，由于阿斯顿·马丁的赛车接受了发动机部件处罚，佩雷斯实际上只会损失一个发车位置——从第19位退到第20位（他原本排位赛取得的位置），排在队友瓦尔特利·博塔斯之后。"
detailEn: Williams Formula 1 driver Carlos Sainz has received a five-place grid penalty for ignoring yellow flags during Azerbaijan Grand Prix qualifying.
The penalty denies Williams what was set to be its best grid position of the year, superseding Alex Albon's 11th place on the Monaco GP grid.

Remarkably, the sanction came on a day on which Sainz was already investigated - and found guilty - of a different yellow-flag breach, although on that occasion he was let off with a reprimand due to mitigating circumstances.

Sainz and Williams were originally hauled in front of the stewards after Friday morning practice for a yellow flag breach through Turn 4. The stewards ruled that Sainz "failed to sufficiently reduce speed" under the yellow flag - but felt there was sufficient mitigation to avoid the imposition of the grid penalty in "the very short period between the single yellow being displayed and Sainz entering the relevant marshalling sector".

No such mitigation was present in a different incident, recorded during the third qualifying segment. In fact, the stewards pointed out that Sainz received advanced warning from the team that a yellow flag was out on the approach to Turn 3, and simply failed to heed it sufficiently.

The warning in question was "yellow ahead, yellow ahead, [Lando] Norris, just do a lift, do a lift, and complete the lap" and then an apparent "clear-clear" that followed seconds later - seemingly creating a situation that led Sainz to believe the yellow flag was no longer acutely relevant.
"[Sainz] explained that he intended to demonstrate a reduction in speed across the yellow area as a whole," the stewards wrote as part of a lengthy explanation.

"He stated that he did not consider it necessary to reduce speed on the straight and instead intended to demonstrate his response when approaching and exiting Turn 3. He considered this to be a 'global lift' covering the consecutive yellow sectors. He further explained that the car [Norris] which had originally caused the yellow was no longer in the runoff area and that he expected the yellow flags to be withdrawn.

"The stewards did not accept this interpretation. Where consecutive marshalling sectors are subject to yellow-flag conditions, a driver must demonstrate a significant reaction to reduce speed in each individual yellow marshalling sector. A reduction in a subsequent sector cannot retrospectively satisfy the requirement applicable to the preceding yellow sector. The obligation is also not dependent on the driver's own assessment of whether the original hazard remains present within a particular part of the yellow sector."

McLaren driver Lando Norris had indeed vacated the relevant runoff by that point - but as the FIA stewards do not want the drivers to self-assess the validity of a yellow flag, they found the lack of any "meaningful reduction in speed" in the relevant marshalling sector was sufficient grounds for the penalty.
In addition to the five-position penalty, which demotes Sainz from ninth to 14th, he has also received two penalty points - taking him to a total of four for the 12-month period.
Sainz was not alone in incurring a grid penalty after Baku qualifying.
A three-position penalty has been assessed against Cadillac driver Sergio Perez for impeding McLaren driver Oscar Piastri in the opening segment.

The stewards wrote that Perez "received two radio warnings" from the team but still forced a needless lift from the McLaren driver through the Turns 18-19-20 section, by "not managing his preparation lap in accordance with specific traffic-management instructions" - namely the race director's order that a driver on a prep lap stay to the right-hand side and avoid weaving in front of incoming cars.

Because of the engine component penalties to the Aston Martin cars, however, Perez is only set to lose one position on the grid - going from 19th to 20th (the position he originally qualified in), behind team-mate Valtteri Bottas.
keyPointsZh: 该处罚取代了亚历克斯·阿尔本在摩纳哥大奖赛排位第11位的成绩，成为威廉姆斯此前的赛季最佳发车位。
罚单出台当天，塞恩斯已因另一起黄旗违规被查实，但仅获训诫。
干事认定他在4号弯黄旗情况下"未能充分减速"，但考虑事发时间极短而免于罚退。
keyPointsEn: The penalty supersedes Alex Albon's 11th place on the Monaco GP grid as Williams's previous best of the year.
The sanction came on the same day Sainz was found guilty of a different yellow-flag breach, for which he received only a reprimand.
The stewards ruled he "failed to sufficiently reduce speed" through Turn 4 but waived a penalty given the very short period involved.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘透露红牛巴库排位赛出问题的真正原因
items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘表示，巴库排位赛中内燃机工作不正常，并由此引发后续问题，导致他在三练最快后未能带来惊喜。

media.altZh: 维斯塔潘透露红牛巴库排位赛出问题的真正原因

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen reveals what really went wrong for Red Bull in Baku F1 qualifying
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen revealed that the internal combustion engine was not working properly during qualifying in Baku, which then led to further problems after he had set the fastest time in final practice.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘透露红牛在巴库F1排位赛中真正出了什么问题
维斯塔潘表示，排位赛期间内燃机运转不正常，随后引发了更多问题。这位红牛车手补充说，如果更换发动机，他不会受到发车位处罚
在最后一次练习赛中做出最快圈速并对升级感到满意之后，维斯塔潘本希望在巴库带来一个惊喜，但发动机问题打乱了计划
起初，这看起来似乎与能量输出问题有关，也就是动力单元电气部分的问题，但在巴库围场里对（规模很小的）荷兰媒体小组讲话时，维斯塔潘澄清了实际情况。
"从第一节排位赛开始，我就遇到了引擎的问题，这意味着比起我的队友，我至少损失了半秒。而且情况越来越糟。在第二节和第三节排位赛中简直是一场灾难，所以我认为我们显然在引擎方面存在问题。"
当Motorsport.com提问时，维斯塔潘澄清说，这个问题最初并非出在能量输出上——尽管看起来可能是——而是出在内燃机上。
"不，不是电气系统的问题。在第一节排位赛中，我们立刻发现了问题。当然，那时候你会想：‘这可能是什么呢？是引擎太冷了，还是其实太热了？’这些都有可能，因为如今这一切都非常敏感。但后来我们清楚了，内燃机确实出了问题。情况越来越糟，到了第三节排位赛，那台引擎已经完全无法正常工作了。"
最初的问题如何导致了后续的挫折
内燃机的这个问题随后引发了诸多其他故障，导致维斯塔潘在周五下午从一个问题陷入另一个问题。
"最高速度变得越来越低。在第三节排位赛的第二圈，我的电池也没法充电，但这显然是因为内燃机出了问题。它造成了很多失火和许多其他问题，完全把系统搞乱了。"
后者在车载镜头中清晰可见。在15号弯和16号弯之间，维斯塔潘的头突然向前一冲，而这段通常应该是全油门通过的路段。
"对，因为我的电池在那里断电了",这位荷兰车手解释道。"因为你在直道上太慢，你自然会在出弯时使用更多电池来试图弥补。结果在某些地方就进入了超级削波（super clipping）状态，而那种削波是相当剧烈的。"
"整套系统完全混乱了。因为速度慢，你在直道上花的时间更长，结果电池消耗也更多。这和本田的情况一样，你也能看到他们比其他所有人都更容易出现电量耗尽（clip）的情况，因为他们必须在直道上更长时间地保持全油门。"
除了引擎本身的问题之外，这也打乱了练习计划。维斯塔潘不得不放弃他的第二个飞驰圈——或者说本应是飞驰圈的一圈——而这又对接下来的整节排位赛产生了影响。
"我不得不放弃那一圈，但这样一来轮胎温度就损失了很多，而这在这里其实非常重要。你能看到所有人都在不停地推进、继续左右摆动轮胎（weave）来保温"，维斯塔潘说，并指出排位赛第三节（Q3）几乎所有人都只跑了一个长距离单圈——这与正常的第三节排位赛不同。
只有迈凯伦选择进了维修通道，但维斯塔潘继续说道："你可以看到这对他们来说其实也不算成功，所以我们干脆继续跑。"
“但如果你不得不放弃一个单圈，那么你在最后一个单圈时轮胎温度就不合适了。而且发动机基本上快要报废了，然后在我最后一圈还出现了黄旗”，他说道，指的是涉及兰多·诺里斯的那次事件。“所以在那个弯角，我至少损失了两个十分之二秒。”
维斯塔潘更换了发动机，但不会受到发车罚退？
红牛目前仍在进一步调查发动机问题，但维斯塔潘的说法表明，他周六的正赛很可能不会使用同一台内燃机（ICE）。不过，这位四届世界冠军立即明确表示，这样的发动机更换不会导致发车罚退。
“嗯，如果仍然存在疑问，我们就必须更换发动机。但我们的发动机储备库里还有另一台可用的发动机。”
不过，当本网站向这位红牛车手提问时，他确认今年晚些时候将接受一次发车处罚。“是的，在某个阶段肯定会有一次处罚。”
理论上，巴库似乎是个接受处罚的绝佳地点，因为在那里看起来有机会超车，但维斯塔潘对此提出了不同看法。
“问题在于，所有人都会在长直道上把电池电量完全耗尽。所以你根本没法利用电池去超车，因为从100%用到0%对每个人来说都是一样的。”
这意味着维斯塔潘将保留他第八位的发车位置，并且在周六依然会把目标放在登上领奖台上，尽管他认为如果没有这次处罚，自己本可以从前排发车。
“这显然非常令人遗憾，因为这一周进展一直很顺利。也许我本来无法追上拉塞尔的圈速，但第一名和第二名之间差距这么大，我们肯定能排在他们两人之间。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen reveals what really went wrong for Red Bull in Baku F1 qualifying

Verstappen says the internal combustion engine was not working properly during qualifying, which then led to further problems. The Red Bull driver adds that he will not receive a grid penalty in the event of an engine change
After setting the fastest time in final practice and feeling good about the upgrades, Verstappen hoped to pull off a surprise in Baku, but an engine problem threw a spanner in the works.

Initially, it appeared to be related to deployment issues and therefore problems on the electrical side of the power unit, but speaking to the (very small) group of Dutch media in the Baku paddock, Verstappen clarified what was actually going on.

"Throughout qualifying, already from Q1, I had a problem with the engine, which meant I was losing at least half a second compared to my team-mate. And it only got worse. In Q2 and Q3 it was a complete disaster, so I think we clearly have a problem with the engine."
When asked by Motorsport.com, Verstappen clarified that the problem was initially not about deployment – as it perhaps seemed – but rather the internal combustion engine.

"No, not on the electrical side. In Q1, we immediately saw a problem. Of course, at that point you still think, ‘What could it be? Is the engine too cold or actually too hot?’ All of that is possible, because it is all very sensitive nowadays. But later it became clear that we really did have a problem with the ICE. It only got worse and in Q3 that engine was no longer working properly at all."
How the initial issue led to further setbacks
That problem with the combustion engine subsequently caused numerous other issues, leaving Verstappen going from one problem to another on Friday afternoon.

"The top speed just became less and less. On that second lap in Q3, my battery wasn’t charging either, but that was obviously because the combustion engine had a problem. That causes a lot of misfires and a lot of other problems, and it confuses the system completely."
The latter was clearly visible in the onboard footage. Between Turns 15 and 16, Verstappen’s head suddenly jolted forward, whereas this would normally be a straightforward flat-out section.

"Yeah, because my battery switched off there", the Dutchman explained. "Because you’re so slow on the straights, you obviously use more battery coming out of the corners to try to compensate for that. As a result, you go into super clipping in some places, and that clip is quite aggressive.

"The whole system was just confused. You spend longer on a straight because you’re going slowly and as a result you use more battery. That’s the same as what happens with Honda, you also see them clipping a lot more than everyone else because they have to spend longer at full throttle on the straights."

Besides the engine problems themselves, this also disrupted the run plan. Verstappen had to abort his second flying lap – or what should have been a flying lap – which in turn had consequences for the remainder of the session.

"I had to abort that lap, but then you lose so much tyre temperature, which is actually very important around here. You could see everyone pushing all the time and continuing to weave", Verstappen said, pointing out that almost everyone in Q3 completed just one long run – unlike in a normal Q3 session.
Only McLaren opted for a visit to the pitlane, but Verstappen continued: "You can see that it wasn’t really a success for them either, so we just kept going.

"But if you have to abort a lap, then you don’t have the right tyre temperature for the very last lap. And the engine is basically breaking down, and then there was a yellow flag on my final lap as well”, he said, referring to the moment involving Lando Norris. “So I had to leave at least two tenths on the table in that corner."
An engine change, but no grid penalty for Verstappen?

Red Bull is currently investigating the engine problem further, but Verstappen’s story makes it seem unlikely that he will start Saturday’s race with the same ICE. However, the four-time world champion immediately makes clear that such an engine change will not result in a grid penalty.
"Well, if there are still question marks, we have to replace the engine. But we still have another engine available in the pool."
A grid penalty will follow later in the year, however, the Red Bull driver confirmed when asked by this website. "Yeah, there definitely has to be a penalty at some point."
In theory, Baku appeared to be quite a good place to take one, as overtaking seems possible, but Verstappen puts that into perspective.
"The problem is that everyone completely drains the battery on the long straight. So you can’t really use the battery to overtake someone, because going from 100 to zero is the same for everyone."
It means Verstappen retains his eighth starting position and will still be aiming for the podium on Saturday, although he believes he could otherwise have started from the front row.

"It’s obviously a real shame, because it had been going well this week. Maybe I wouldn’t have matched George’s time, but there’s such a big gap between P1 and P2, we definitely would have been somewhere in between."
